name: caffeinate
description: macOS sleep-prevention CLI + sourceable shell lib over /usr/bin/caffeinate: read who holds power assertions; start/stop/run are preview-by-default --yes writes that touch only processes this tool started, every one timed out and audited
hits: macOS power management (caffeinate / pmset, this machine only)
surface: CLI `caff` + `lib/caffeinate.sh`. `status`/`assertions` are free. `start`, `stop`, `run` preview and exit 0 until re-run with `--yes` (flag tier: own process, reversible). Every `start` carries a timeout (default 1h, 8h code ceiling, no forever). `stop` signals only a PID recorded in its own registry that `ps` still reports as caffeinate; there is no stop-all/pkill verb. Audit line to stderr and data/audit.log on every mutation.

origin.note: Local hello-* workshop with no commits and no remote (git init only), so there is no vendored_commit and bin/vendor.sh could not archive HEAD: copied by hand from the working tree — lib/caffeinate.sh, examples/01-04, docs/01-03, README.md, .gitignore (all untracked in the source). .DS_Store excluded. lib/caffeinate.sh is edited here: caff_stop_all (pkill caffeinate) removed, caff_stop refuses a PID that is not a caffeinate process, caff_is_caffeinate added. The CLI `caff`, the tests and this manifest are authored in the belt.

env.name: CAFF_HOME
env.description: Where the PID registry (pids) and audit.log live. Default: <tool dir>/data (gitignored). Tests point it at a temp dir.

auth.flow: none — /usr/bin/caffeinate and pmset run as the operator on the local machine; no credential exists and nothing leaves the host

safeguards: Read-first: status and assertions are pgrep/pmset reads and change nothing; they are the only verbs without a flag (SENSIBILITIES #1)

start, stop and run preview by default — cmd_start/cmd_stop/cmd_run in caff print the exact caffeinate invocation and exit 0 — and execute only with --yes, which is always honored (flag tier: the operator's own process on the operator's own machine, reversible with one stop) (SENSIBILITIES #2)

Every start expires: DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S=3600 and MAX_TIMEOUT_S=28800 are code constants in caff; --timeout 0/forever is refused and a value past the ceiling exits 2 naming the constant (SENSIBILITIES #3)

Own-process only: cmd_stop signals a PID only if it is in data/pids (written by this tool's start) AND caff_is_caffeinate (lib/caffeinate.sh) confirms ps reports it as caffeinate; a foreign or reused PID is refused with exit 1. caff_stop_all / pkill caffeinate was removed from the lib and no verb exposes it — a caffeinate another session holds is not this tool's to kill

Audit line [caff audit] with timestamp, verb and target on every start/stop/run, to stderr and to data/audit.log (mode 600); after a start the tool re-reads pmset -g assertions and reports whether the new PID holds an assertion (SENSIBILITIES #7, #2)
No credential, no network, no host but this one; data/ holds PIDs and audit lines only (SENSIBILITIES #11)

verbs.name: status
verbs.note: every caffeinate PID on the machine, which of them this tool started, the pmset assertion lines

verbs.name: start
verbs.note: preview → --yes; background caffeinate with a mandatory timeout (default 1h, ceiling 8h); prints the `caff stop <pid> --yes` undo

verbs.name: stop
verbs.note: preview → --yes; only a PID this tool started and ps still shows as caffeinate; --mine stops all of those

verbs.name: run
verbs.note: preview → --yes; caffeinate wraps the command so the assertion ends with it; the command itself is whatever the caller passes

verbs.name: stop-all / pkill caffeinate
verbs.note: removed from lib/caffeinate.sh; no verb signals a process this tool did not start

smoke_test.expect: status reads pgrep/pmset; start --explain previews and starts nothing; tests green — no test passes --yes to start or run, so no assertion is ever held; the caffeinate process set is asserted unchanged

risk.worst_case: this Mac stays awake for up to 8 hours (the code ceiling) under an assertion the operator forgot, or a command the caller named runs under `caff run --yes`; nothing leaves the host and no process this tool did not start is ever signalled
